description: This Java source file contains a test class 'WidgetMacroLibraryTests' which is used to verify the correctness of various macro library outputs within the OFBiz widget module. The tests involve HTTP requests to specific endpoints, validating response content types, and checking for macro errors in different formats such as HTML, XML, CSV, XLS, and PDF.

classes.name: WidgetMacroLibraryTests
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending OFBizTestCase, designed to test various macro library endpoints by sending HTTP requests and validating the responses for errors and correct content types.

methods.name: initHttpClient
methods.description: Initializes and configures an HttpClient instance with redirect following, untrusted certificates, and host verification disabled.

methods.name: testHtmlMacroLibrary
methods.description: Tests the HTML macro library endpoint for proper response and absence of macro errors.

methods.name: testTextMacroLibrary
methods.description: Tests the Text macro library endpoint for proper response and absence of macro errors.

methods.name: testXmlMacroLibrary
methods.description: Tests the XML macro library endpoint for proper response and absence of macro errors.

methods.name: testCsvMacroLibrary
methods.description: Tests the CSV macro library endpoint for proper response and absence of macro errors.

methods.name: testXlsMacroLibrary
methods.description: Tests the XLS macro library endpoint for proper response and absence of macro errors.

methods.name: testFopMacroLibrary
methods.description: Tests the FOP (PDF) macro library endpoint for proper PDF response and absence of macro errors, including parsing the PDF stream.
